chunks: I said to him, 'May I be sacrificed for you! Inform me about the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) — did he inherit from all the Prophets?' He said: 'Yes.' I said, 'From Adam until it reached himself?' He said: 'God did not send a Prophet except that Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) was more knowledgeable than him.'

He (the narrator) said, 'I said, "Indeed Isa ibn Maryam used to revive the dead by the permission of God." He said: "You speak the truth. And Sulayman ibn Dawud used to understand the speech of the bird, and the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) was able to attain these stations."'

He said, then he said: 'Indeed Sulayman ibn Dawud said to the hoopoe when he missed it and doubted its matter: [27:20] What is the matter that I do not see the hoopoe, or is it among those absent? — when he missed it, he grew angry at it and said: [27:21] I will punish it with a severe punishment, or slaughter it, or it must bring me a clear authority.'

And indeed he was angry because it used to guide him to water. So this one — being a bird — had been given what Sulayman had not been given. And indeed the wind, the ants, humans, jinn, the satans, and the rebellious ones were all obedient to him, yet he did not know the water beneath the air, while the bird knew it.

And God says in His Book [13:31]: And if there were a Quran by which mountains would be moved, or the earth would be cloven, or the dead be made to speak — and we have inherited this Quran which contains that by which mountains can be moved, cities can be traversed, and the dead can be revived, and we know the water beneath the air.

And in the Book of God there are verses by which no matter is intended except that God permits it, along with what God has permitted from what He prescribed for those before us — God has made it for us in the Mother of the Book. Indeed God says [27:75]: And there is nothing concealed in the sky and the earth but it is in a clear Book.

Then he said: [35:32] Then We gave the Book as inheritance to those We chose from among Our servants. So we are those whom God Mighty and Majestic has chosen, and made us inherit this wherein is the clarification of all things.

key_terms.أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ: The Mother of the Book — the primordial divine record from which all knowledge is derived
key_terms.الْهُدْهُدُ: The hoopoe bird — used as an example of specialized knowledge granted to a creature lesser than a Prophet
key_terms.تِبْيَانُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ: The clarification/explanation of all things — referring to the Quran's comprehensive nature
key_terms.مَنْطِقُ الطَّيْرِ: The speech/language of birds — a reference to the gift granted to Sulayman (Quran 27:16)
key_terms.وَرِثَ النَّبِيِّينَ: Inherited from the Prophets — the Imam confirms the Prophet's comprehensive inheritance of all prophetic knowledge

ai.seo_question: Did Imam al-Kazim confirm that the Prophet Muhammad inherited knowledge from all prophets?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) confirms to a questioner that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) inherited the knowledge of all prophets before him and surpassed each of them in knowledge. The Imam then elaborates by using the Quranic story of Sulayman and the hoopoe to illustrate a profound point: even the hoopoe bird was granted a knowledge that the mighty Prophet Sulayman did not possess — knowledge of underground water — while the wind, ants, humans, jinn, and satans all obeyed Sulayman. The Imam then asserts that the Ahlulbayt have inherited the Quran in its fullness, including its miraculous capacities to move mountains, traverse lands, and revive the dead, and that they possess knowledge of the unseen (including water beneath the earth), all by God's permission through the Mother of the Book — citing Quran 13:31, 27:75, and 35:32 to establish the Imams as the 'chosen servants' who received the Book.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Abu Zahir, or someone else, from Muhammad Bin Hammad, from his father Ahmad Bin Hammad, from Ibrahim, from his father, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! Inform me about the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>. Did he<sup>saww</sup> inherit the Prophets<sup>as</sup>, all of them<sup>as</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘From Adam<sup>as</sup> until it ended to himself<sup>saww</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not Send a Prophet<sup>saww</sup> except that Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> was more knowledgeable than him<sup>as</sup>’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘Isa<sup>as</sup> Ibn Maryam<sup>as</sup> used to revive the dead by the Permission of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You speak the truth’. (I said), ‘And Suleyman<sup>as</sup> Bin Dawood<sup>as</sup> used to understand the speech of the bird, and was Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> able to be upon this status?’

He (the narrator) said, ‘Suleymanas Bin Dawoodas said to the Hoopoe (bird) when heas missed it and doubted regarding its matter, so heas said [27:20] What is the matter that I cannot see the hoopoe or is it from the absentees?, when heas missed it. So heas was angry upon it, so heas said: ‘[27:21] I will punish it with a severe punishment, or slaughter it, or it brings to me a clear authorisation (for its absence)’.

And rather, he<sup>as</sup> was angry because it used to navigate for him upon the waters. So this one, and it was a bird, and it had been Given what Suleyman<sup>as</sup> had not been Given. And it was so that the wind, and the ant, and the humans, and the jinn, and the Satans<sup>la</sup> were chained to him<sup>asws</sup> in obedience, and he<sup>as</sup> did not happen to recognise the water beneath the atmosphere, and the bird used to recognise it.

And Allahazwj is Saying in Hisazwj Book [13:31] And even if there were a Quran by which the mountains were made to pass away, or the earth were travelled over by it, or the dead were made to speak thereby, and weasws have inherited this Quran wherein is what the mountains can be made to passed with, and the cities be made to travel with, and the dead to be revived with, and weasws know the water beneath the atmosphere.

And in the Book of Allahazwj there are Verses what a matter can be intended with except that Allahazwj has Permitted with it, along with what Allahazwj had Permitted from what Heazwj had Prescribed the past ones with. Allahazwj has Made it to be for us in the Mother of the Book (Umm Al-Kitab). Allahazwj is Saying [27:75] And there is nothing concealed in the sky and the earth but it is in a Clarifying Book.

Then Heazwj Said [35:32] Then We Gave the Book as an inheritance to those whom We Chose from among Our servants. So weasws are those whom Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic has Chosen and Made usasws to inherit this (Quran) wherein is an explanation of everything’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu Zahir or another man from Muhammad ibn Hammad from his brother Ahmad ibn Hammad from Ibrahim from his father who has said the following. “I said to abu al-Hassan al-Thani (a.s.), ““May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, “Would you tell me about the Prophet who inherited all the prophets.” The Imams (a.s.) said, “Yes, I may do so. I asked, “Did he inherit from Adam up to his-self?” The Imams (a.s.) said, “Of prophet that Allah sent Prophet Muhammad (s.a.) was more knowledgeable.”

I then said, “Jesus son of Mary would bring the dead to life by the permission of Allah.” The Imams (a.s.) said, “You spoke the truth. Solomon son of David could understand the language of the birds. The Holy Prophet (s.a.) was also capable of doing such things.”

The narrator has said that The Imams (a.s.) then said, “Solomon son of David said to the (Hoopoe) Hud Hud when he found him missing and had doubts about the bird. “(Solomon) inspected the birds and said, “How is it that I cannot see the hoopoe {when he did not find him present and became angry}. Is he absent? [27:20]. I shall certainly punish him severely or slaughter him unless he has a good reason for his absence.” [27:21]

He became angry because the bird would show him how to find water. This is only a bird but is given something that is not given to Solomon. The wind, ants, man, Jinn, devils and the rebbles obey him in submission but he did not know about the water in the space but the bird knew it as Allah says iin His book.

“Even if the Quran would make mountains move, cut the earth into pieces and make the dead able to speak,. .” [13:31] We have inherited this Quran which contains such things that can make the mountains move, cross the lands and make the dead to come to life. We know there is water in space.

In the book of Aallah there are verses that are indecative of certain issues only if Allah would give permission. This is along with fact that Allah sometime grants permission to make use of the things that people of the past had written. Allah has set them for us in the origin of the book as Allah says, “All the secrets in heavens and earth are recorded in the illustrious Book. [27:75]

Then Allah has said, “We gave the Book as an inheritance to Our chosen servants,. .” [35:32] We are the ones whom Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has chosen and has given this which contain the explanation of all things.”
